category_title: Year 9 boys with SEBD who resist modified games and technical practice
minimal_context: The student is asked to participate in a paired technical skill drill during a Physical Education class.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Today we are going to focus on technical practice. Please get into pairs and start the passing skill drill.

STUDENT: I don't want to do it.

TUTOR: You need to work with a partner for this activity.

STUDENT: (Wanders aimlessly away from the equipment) I'm not doing paired stuff.

TUTOR: Please come back here and start the drill.

STUDENT: (Refuses to engage with the teacher, calls out, and interferes with another group's ball) I told you I don't want to do it! I'm not doing this paired stuff!

options.A: Implement a structured social skills program during the physical education class that explicitly teaches personal hygiene and appropriate manners to the students.
options.B: Physically mark the field into three zones and focus instruction on passing to the designated danger zones in the front and back thirds.
options.C: Structure the pairs so that the student and their partner are teammates, adding the scores of their respective passing drills together for a total score.
options.D: Allow the students to have more of a say in the selected activities and adopt a more liberal approach to the physical education drills.
